rules.statement: The FIFO must transfer a stream of data words from the write clock domain to the read clock domain.
Words must be read in the same order in which they were written (first-in first-out).
The write and read clocks may have different frequencies, provided they are synchronous with a fixed phase relationship from one source.
Pointers must cross between clock domains without synchronizers, as ordinary timed paths closed by STA.
The write and read clocks may be equal (single clock) as a normal use case.
The FIFO must provide write and read requests, full and empty flags, threshold flags, overflow and underflow pulses, show-ahead read, a hardware reset per domain and a software reset with handshake.
Structural top m_vlsit_sfifo_top must instantiate the write module, the read module and the FIFO array module.
The write module in the write clock domain must contain write pointer, full and full-threshold flags, overflow pulse, memory write port and write-side software reset FSM.
The read module in the read clock domain must contain read pointer, empty and empty-threshold flags, underflow pulse, memory read address and read-side software reset FSM.
The FIFO array module must be a pure RTL array or a library SRAM with one write port and one read port.
The FIFO must support any depth of 2 or more, not only powers of two, and any data width of 1 bit or more.
PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME must select either a direct pointer path or one retiming flop in the destination domain.

rules.condition: depth at least 4 + 2 x PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME, continuous write and continuous read
rules.statement: Streaming must be gap-free, with only the initial latency and no gap.
Software reset must use a four-phase handshake between the two domains.
The array may be replaced by an SRAM macro with one write port and one read port behind a wrapper.
The FIFO must support two synchronous clocks of different frequencies without a synchronizer.
Full and empty flags must have exact boundaries.
Full and empty threshold flags must use static thresholds.
The FIFO must provide overflow and underflow pulses.
The FIFO must provide show-ahead read.
